verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live production REST API platform and a developer hub, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the pack documents an interactive reference or runnable examples: the developer hub's contents were never fetched (its robots.txt disallows all crawlers but Googlebot), and the gov.uk pages cover only end-user tax services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
